Name: Automated Mining Drills - Wayback Pelican Town Recolor
Author: CaseyMazey
Description:
I love the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9291?tab=posts]Automated Mining Drills[/url] mod by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/drewdus42?gameId=1303]drewdus42[/url]. Since it is pretty colorful, I decided to recolor it to fit better with the "wooden" style of wayback pelican town.


Install:

Go into \[CP] Automated Mining Drills\assets and ovewrite the pic there.


This is my first mod/recolor ever. I hope you like it.


If anyone wants some other recolor styles (pastels etc.) I'd be happy to help.
